title: a usage reader tool writes the account's usage to one JSON file, keeping a failed fetch beside the last good reading
intention: cairn/tools/usage/ reads the account's usage with one HTTPS GET, writes ~/.cairn/usage/usage.json carrying fetched_at, and keeps a failed fetch beside the last good reading, never in its place.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: no cairn/tools/usage exists; the orchestrator's draft C:/Users/akien/usage_draft.py implements read_and_write, last and a --hook entry; ~/.claude/.credentials.json exists on this box (contents not read)
traces_to: Law 7 (a failed fetch is permanent in the record, never a fresh-looking reading); Law 3 (a usage figure is a measurement with an age); CP4; Law 6 (a tool has users).
how: Start from the orchestrator's draft (C:/Users/akien/usage_draft.py): read_and_write(fetch=...) and last(), a --hook entry that always exits 0, and the token scrubbed from every record and output. Charter first, red-first proof with the fetch injected and urlopen patched to raise.

clauses.claim: a good injected fetch writes percent and resets_at for seven_day and five_hour with fetched_at, and last() reads it fresh with its age
a failing fetch after a good one is written as an error beside the unchanged last_good, and last() reports state error with the old reading, never fresh
the OAuth token appears in neither the store file nor anything printed, including when the fetch's own error message contains it
a missing credentials file or an empty token is a recorded error, and --hook returns 0 on every failure
the proof reaches no network: urlopen is patched to raise during every tooth

decisions.text: D1: the fix at cairn/tools/usage/__init__.py, cairn/tools/usage/__main__.py, cairn/tools/usage/usage.py
D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: no cairn/tools/usage exists; the orchestrator's draft C:/Users/akien/usage_draft.py implements read_and_write, last and a --hook entry; ~/.claude/.credentials.json exists on this box (contents not read)
measured.how: directory listing of cairn/tools; read the draft; Test-Path on the credentials file

measured.saw: NOT measured: the real reply shape of https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage (the draft's keys seven_day, five_hour, utilization, resets_at are its author's), and whether the token in the credentials file is accepted: HYPOTHESIS; no network call was made
measured.how: none: the build and its proof use an injected fetch by design
